acceptance_criteria.criterion: handleListDialogues(ledgerRoot, slug) returns [] when the dialogues/ directory is absent (no error thrown).
handleListDialogues(ledgerRoot, slug) returns all .md filenames in the directory, sorted alphabetically, when wp is not provided.
handleListDialogues(ledgerRoot, slug, 'WP-001') returns only filenames starting with 'WP-001-'.
handleGetDialogueFile(ledgerRoot, slug, 'WP-001-developer-r0.md') returns the file content when the file exists.
handleGetDialogueFile(ledgerRoot, slug, '../secret.md') throws ApiError NOT_FOUND (filename allowlist rejects it).
handleGetDialogueFile(ledgerRoot, slug, 'WP-999-developer-r0.md') throws ApiError NOT_FOUND when the file does not exist.
GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues route is registered in server.ts and calls handleListDialogues.
GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues/:filename route is registered in server.ts and calls handleGetDialogueFile.
npx vitest run mcp-server/tests/gui/api.test.ts passes with no failures, including all pre-existing tests.
